originalTitle: Zuckerberg faces questions over why superyacht reportedly declined to help stranded boat
summary: Small cruise ship rescued skiff in south-east Alaska even though Meta billionaire’s $300m megayacht was closer
content: Mark Zuckerberg has faced questions over why a small cruise ship in south-east Alaska rescued a stranded skiff and its crew when his 387ft superyacht had been closer. The Silicon Valley billionaire’s yacht, worth a reported $300m, is said to have “repeatedly” declined to assist when a nearby boat called for help last week. Zuckerberg, CEO of Facebook and Instagram owner Meta Platforms, was not on board at the time, a spokesperson told Forbes. When a nearby 21ft skiff ran out of fuel between Petersburg and Juneau, the Alaska Beacon reported operators of a cruise ship that was further away than Zuckerberg’s yacht came to the rescue. “I’m on a small-ship Alaska cruise with my son,” a passenger on the UnCruise Adventures ship Wilderness Legacy posted on Bluesky. “Our boat rescued a stranded vessel last night and apparently we did that after the Coast Guard radioed Mark Zuckerberg’s yacht – which was closer – and they repeatedly refused to respond. (There was near unanimous booing when the captain announced this).” But Brian Baker, a spokesperson for Zuckerberg and his wife, Priscilla Chan, told Forbes that the couple were not on board his yacht, named Launchpad. The yacht crew had been operating on a different radio channel, Baker told Forbes. “The assist was already under way” by the time they reviewed the broadcast, he said. Even if he was not on his ship, the report is unlikely to boost public opinion of Zuckerberg, who has faced criticism over the societal impact of his social media platforms; his new warm relationship with Donald Trump; and his lavish, insular lifestyle. “I live in Juneau and I’ve been having to look at that excessive eyesore parked up in [Auke Bay] for too long now,” a Reddit user wrote of the yacht in response to the rescue story. “Fuck Zuckerberg.”
chineseTitle: 扎克伯格面临质疑，为何据报道超级游艇拒绝帮助搁浅的船只
chineseSummary: 小型游轮在阿拉斯加东南部救起了小船，尽管梅塔亿万富翁价值 3 亿美元的巨型游艇距离更近
chineseContent: 马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 面临着这样一个问题：为什么阿拉斯加东南部的一艘小型游轮在他的 387 英尺超级游艇距离较近的情况下营救了一艘搁浅的小船及其船员。据报道，这位硅谷亿万富翁的游艇价值 3 亿美元，据说上周附近一艘船求救时，该游艇“多次”拒绝提供帮助。一位发言人告诉《福布斯》，Facebook 和 Instagram 所有者 Meta Platforms 的首席执行官扎克伯格当时并不在场。据《阿拉斯加灯塔》报道，当附近一艘 21 英尺长的小船在圣彼得堡和朱诺之间耗尽燃料时，比扎克伯格的游艇更远的一艘游轮的运营商前来救援。 “我和儿子一起乘坐阿拉斯加小船巡游，”UnCruise Adventures 游轮荒野遗产号上的一名乘客在 Bluesky 上发帖说。 “我们的船昨晚营救了一艘搁浅的船只，显然是在海岸警卫队通过无线电向距离较近的马克·扎克伯格的游艇发出无线电信号后，我们才采取了行动，但他们一再拒绝回应。（当船长宣布这一消息时，几乎全场响起了一致的嘘声）。”但扎克伯格和他的妻子普里西拉·陈 (Priscilla Chan) 的发言人布莱恩·贝克 (Brian Baker) 告诉《福布斯》，这对夫妇并不在他名为 Launchpad 的游艇上。贝克告诉福布斯，游艇船员一直在不同的无线电频道上工作。他说，当他们查看广播时，“援助已经开始”。即使扎克伯格不在船上，该报告也不太可能提升公众对扎克伯格的看法，因为扎克伯格的社交媒体平台的社会影响一直受到批评。他与唐纳德·特朗普建立了新的友好关系；以及他奢华而与世隔绝的生活方式。 “我住在朱诺，我已经不得不看着停在奥克湾的那艘碍眼的游艇太久了，”一位 Reddit 用户在回应救援故事时这样描述这艘游艇。 “去他妈的扎克伯格。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
